headline: Exxaro Tiles informs exchange about trading window opening
hook: Routine trading window closure at Exxaro
summary: Exxaro Tiles Limited has officially notified the stock exchanges regarding the opening of its trading window. This procedural compliance filing is standard for listed companies around financial reporting periods. Retail investors are not impacted by this routine corporate governance update. No financial results or operational data were released in this notice.
why_it_matters: Standard procedural compliance with no direct impact on stock price.

headline: Exxaro Tiles files financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026
summary: Exxaro Tiles Limited has officially submitted its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges. The filing provides the company's financial performance metrics for the second quarter of the fiscal year. Retail shareholders and market participants can review the reported revenue, profit, and margin figures to gauge the company's operational health.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings data updates your investment thesis on Exxaro Tiles.
